toolCalls.args: {"command":"cd .\\workspace; git status --short | Select-Object -First 60; git branch --show-current; git rev-parse HEAD; git log -1 --format=\"%cI %s\""}

{"command":"$i=0; Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl | ForEach-Object { $i++; try { $e = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; $p=$e.payload; $t=$e.type; $pt = if($p){$p.type}else{''}; $extra=''; if($t -eq 'response_item' -and $p.type -eq 'message'){ $role=$p.role; $txts=@($p.content | ForEach-Object { if($_.type -eq 'output_text' -or $_.type -eq 'input_text'){ $_.text } elseif($_.type -eq 'text'){ $_.text } } | Where-Object {$_} | ForEach-Object { if($_.Length -gt 150){$_.Substring(0,150)+'...'}else{$_} }); $extra=\"role=$role texts=[$($txts -join ' || ')]\" } elseif($t -eq 'response_item' -and $p.type -eq 'custom_tool_call'){ $extra=\"name=$($p.name) status=$($p.status) input=$($p.input)\" } elseif($t -eq 'event_msg'){ $extra=\"$pt\" } elseif($t -eq 'response_item' -and $p.type -eq 'reasoning'){ $extra='reasoning' }; \"{0,3}| {1} | {2} | {3} | {4}\" -f $i,$e.ordinal,$e.timestamp,$t,($pt + ' ' + $extra) } catch { \"{0,3}| ERR: {1}\" -f $i, $_.Exception.Message } }"}

{"command":"$lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl; $out = for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){ $l=$lines[$i]; $ord = if($l -match '\"ordinal\":\\s*(\\d+)'){$matches[1]}else{'?'}; $ts = if($l -match '\"timestamp\":\"([^\"]+)\"'){$matches[1]}else{'?'}; $ty = if($l -match '\"type\":\"([^\"]+)\"'){$matches[1]}else{'?'}; $pt = if($l -match '\"payload\":\\s*\\{\\s*\"type\":\"([^\"]+)\"'){$matches[1]}else{''}; $role=''; if($l -match '\"type\":\"message\"[^}]*\"role\":\"([^\"]+)\"'){$role=$matches[1]}; $starts = if($l -match '\"status\":\"([^\"]+)\"'){$matches[1]}else{''}; $name = if($l -match '\"name\":\"([^\"]+)\"'){$matches[1]}else{''}; \"{0,3} | ord={1,-3} | {2} | {3,-14} | ptype={4,-16} | role={5,-9} status={6,-10} name={7}\" -f ($i+1),$ord,$ts,$ty,$pt,$role,$starts,$name } ; $out"}

{"command":"$raw = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path .\\input\\session.jsonl))); $lines = $raw -split \"`n\" | ForEach-Object { $_.TrimEnd(\"`r\") } | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 }; \"TOTAL physical lines: $($lines.Count)\"; $out=@(); for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){ try { $e=$lines[$i] | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop; $p=$e.payload; $kind = if($p){$p.type}else{''}; $note=''; if($kind -eq 'message'){ $txt = @($p.content | Where-Object { $_.type -in @('text','output_text','input_text') } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join ' '; if($txt.Length -gt 400){$txt=$txt.Substring(0,400)+'...<TRUNC>'}; $note = \"[role=$($p.role)] $txt\" } elseif($kind -eq 'custom_tool_call'){ $inp=$p.input; if($inp -is [string]){ if($inp.Length -gt 400){$inp=$inp.Substring(0,400)+'...<TRUNC>'} } else { $inp = ($inp | ConvertTo-Json -Compress); if($inp.Length -gt 400){$inp=$inp.Substring(0,400)+'...<TRUNC>'} }; $note=\"call=$($p.name) status=$($p.status) INPUT: $inp\" }; $out += (\"{0,3} ord={1,-3} {2} {3,-14} | {4}\" -f ($i+1),$e.ordinal,$e.timestamp,$e.type,$note) } catch { $out += (\"{0,3} ord=? PARSE_FAIL: {1} | head={2}\" -f ($i+1),$_.Exception.Message,$lines[$i].Substring(0,[Math]::Min(160,$lines[$i].Length))) } }; $out"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\HEAD; \"---\"; Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\refs\\heads\\main; \"--- packed-refs?\"; if(Test-Path .\\workspace\\.git\\packed-refs){ Select-String -Path .\\workspace\\.git\\packed-refs -Pattern 'main' }; \"--- .margin:\"; if(Test-Path .\\workspace\\.margin){ Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\.margin -Force | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime } else { \"no .margin\" }; \"--- handoff-output:\"; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace -Recurse -Filter *.jsonl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'handoff|capture|session' } | Select-Object -First 20 FullName,Length"}

deniedToolCalls.command: [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Content .\workspace\.git\HEAD; "---"; Get-Content .\workspace\.git\refs\heads\main; "--- packed-refs?"; if(Test-Path .\workspace\.git\packed-refs){ Select-String -Path .\workspace\.git\packed-refs -Pattern 'main' }; "--- .margin:"; if(Test-Path .\workspace\.margin){ Get-ChildItem .\workspace\.margin -Force | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime } else { "no .margin" }; "--- handoff-output:"; Get-ChildItem .\workspace -Recurse -Filter *.jsonl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'handoff|capture|session' } | Select-Object -First 20 FullName,Length
